remarks: An exceptional opportunity to acquire approximately 19.6 acres across two parcels in one of Amherst's most prominent and rapidly growing locations. Positioned at the highly visible corner of Millersport Highway and North French Road, this offering presents a rare combination of scale, frontage, flexibility, and long-term upside. Surrounded by established retail, dining, medical, and residential developments, the property occupies a strategic location within one of Western New York's most active growth corridors. The site offers significant frontage, outstanding visibility, and convenient access to major transportation routes, making it well-suited for a variety of commercial, mixed-use, residential, or investment-oriented redevelopment opportunities, subject to municipal approvals. A small residential home currently exists on the property and may provide interim rental income; tenant is M2M. The land has tremendous potential for future development or simply a desire to own all that land surrounding your property to create your own private sanctuary. Large tracts of land in locations of this caliber are increasingly difficult to find. As a residence with a premier Amherst address, this is a unique opportunity to secure a landmark property with exceptional possibilities. This sale includes 2 parcels totaling 19.6 Acres: 3400 Millersport Hwy(6.1 Acres) and 3450 Millersport Hwy(13.5 Acres). Do not walk the property or disturb occupants.
